title: Unconscious surfer rescued by Coast Guard near Newport, Oregon
description:
A Coast Guard Air Facility Newport aircrew rescued an unconscious surfer at Devil’s Punchbowl State Park, in Oregon on Dec. 1, 2018. 

The crew, aboard an MH-65 Dolphin helicopter, located the subject, deployed a rescue swimmer and with assistance from a local surfer, brought the unconscious subject back to the beach on a surfboard. 

U.S. Coast Guard video by Senior Chief Petty Officer Chris Hinote.
